purpose: Owner-approved C3 Guardian implementation preview. Hopper refinement is concept-only pending owner approval; all rejected designs are excluded from runtime.

guardian.layout: Irregular four-row reference sheet. Explicit per-pose source rectangles; never divide the artwork into uniform cells.
